name: Ouled el-Hadef (Old Town)
description: The atmospheric medieval heart of Tozeur, a maze of narrow lanes lined with ochre-yellow walls laid in the town's signature geometric brick relief. Compact and walkable, it holds a small museum, craft shops and centuries of oasis history, and is best explored slowly on foot.

name: Palmeraie and Belvedere
tagline: The green oasis and its lookout rocks
description: The vast palm grove of hundreds of thousands of date palms fed by springs, laced with irrigation channels and best toured by caleche. The nearby Belvedere rocks offer sweeping views over the palmeraie and Chott el-Jerid, especially at sunset, making this the town's natural green escape.
bestFor: Nature walks, sunset views, slow travel
cons: Not a place to stay or work

name: Modern Town and Tourist Zone
tagline: Hotels, services and the main strip
description: The newer part of Tozeur along Avenue Habib Bourguiba and the tourist-zone hotels, where you will find most restaurants, shops, banks, tour operators and the steadiest wifi. It is the practical base for nomads who want amenities close by and easy access to onward transport and desert excursions.
pros: Easy access to tours and transport
cons: Less atmospheric than the old town

name: Nefta and the Mountain Oases
tagline: Nearby oasis towns and dramatic gorges
description: Just west sits Nefta, a serene oasis town with its own palmeraie and Sufi heritage, while north lie the mountain oases of Chebika, Tamerza and Mides with waterfalls, gorges and cliff-top views. These make superb day trips or a quieter alternative base for travelers chasing pure desert scenery.
cons: Requires a car or tour to reach
